# ISDOC Viewer

> A free, installable web app (PWA) that opens ISDOC and ISDOCX invoices (the Czech electronic invoice format) in the browser, renders them with XSLT, verifies the electronic signature, validates the document against the official XSD schemas and offers a QR code for paying the invoice. Everything runs locally on your device (in the browser or as an installed app); files are never uploaded.

Site: https://isdoc.80.cz/ · Source code (MIT): https://github.com/heptau/isdoc

What it does:
- Opens `.isdoc` and `.isdocx` files (drag & drop, file picker, or as an installed app). Attachments of an ISDOCX archive can be downloaded.
- Accepts a document from another page via `postMessage` (messages `isdoc-ready` / `isdoc-file` / `isdoc-received`, see `integrate.html` and the README) and from the system Share sheet (Web Share Target, POST to `share-target`). Nothing is sent through a URL.
- Renders invoices with three XSLT layouts: Standard, UOL IIS (laid out for a Czech window envelope) and Source code (syntax-highlighted XML).
- Eight languages for the app and, independently, for the invoice: Czech, Slovak, English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese.
- Checks the XMLDSig signature (digests and signature value via WebCrypto; shows signer, issuer, validity and SHA-256 fingerprints of the certificate and public key). It does not check the trust chain or revocation of the certificate.
- Can print a signature note on the invoice (signer, time, certificate fingerprint, SHA-256 hash of the file) for validly signed documents.
- Lets the user mark a certificate (by SHA-256 fingerprint) as trusted; documents signed by it are then shown as "valid and trusted". The list stays in the browser.
- Signs the loaded invoice with the "Sign" button (enveloped XMLDSig, SHA-256, RSA/ECDSA) using a certificate and unencrypted private key added from PEM files; the key stays in the browser (IndexedDB, non-extractable) and the signed file is downloaded.
- Detects the ISDOC version and validates against the ISDOC XSD schemas (5.2.2 to 6.0.2) with a list of errors and line numbers.
- Still displays invalid documents: repairs typical defects, shows non-ISDOC XML as source code and malformed XML as numbered text.
- Creates the Czech QR payment (SPAYD) and the SEPA/EPC QR code (any currency) from the payment details of the invoice.
- Works offline after the first visit.

Privacy: no data leaves your device, there is no server-side processing, no analytics and no external requests at runtime.

## Docs

- [Web app](https://isdoc.80.cz/): open an ISDOC or ISDOCX file and view it
- [README](https://github.com/heptau/isdoc/blob/main/README.md): features, running locally, project layout, how to add a language, layout or schema
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/heptau/isdoc/blob/main/AGENTS.md): notes for AI coding agents and contributors (conventions, gotchas, licensing rules)
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/heptau/isdoc/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): licenses of bundled libraries and the ISDOC schemas
- [License](https://github.com/heptau/isdoc/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT for the project's own code

## Sample files

All sample invoices are fictional.

- [Unsigned invoice (CZK)](https://isdoc.80.cz/samples/ukazka-nepodepsana.isdoc)
- [Signed invoice, valid signature](https://isdoc.80.cz/samples/ukazka-podepsana.isdoc)
- [Signed invoice, C14N 1.0 and SHA-1](https://isdoc.80.cz/samples/ukazka-podepsana-c14n10-sha1.isdoc)
- [Signed invoice, tampered after signing](https://isdoc.80.cz/samples/ukazka-podpis-neplatny.isdoc)
- [Invoice in EUR with IBAN and BIC](https://isdoc.80.cz/samples/ukazka-eur.isdoc)
- [ISDOCX archive with an attachment](https://isdoc.80.cz/samples/ukazka.isdocx)

## Optional

- [ISDOC format and schemas](https://isdoc.cz/): the official specification of the ISDOC format
- [QR Platba](https://qr-platba.cz/): the Czech QR payment standard and its graphic manual
